I'll think this through as this farmer would, then give the JSON.

**My reasoning:**

I have 3.5 mu. Not big land. Six mouths, but some of my children work outside and send money, so I manage the field mostly by myself with my husband helping when he's home. I do what I always do — wheat after autumn, maize after wheat. This is how everyone in our village farms. I cannot read, but I know my land. Thirty years I've worked it.

For the wheat, I plant in October like every year. I buy the same seed the shop sells — the one my neighbor Liu uses, he got good harvest last year so I trust it. For one mu of wheat I put one bag of 复合肥 (compound fertilizer, 50 jin) when I plow, then when the wheat turns green in spring I spread one bag of 尿素 (urea) on top. That's what my husband's uncle taught us and it works. If I put less, I'm afraid the wheat will be yellow and thin. Better to spend the money than see a bad field — the neighbors would laugh and we'd eat less.

I water the wheat with the well — once before winter so it doesn't dry out, once when it greens up, once when it's heading, once when the grain is filling. Four times. The electricity for the pump costs money but without water nothing grows here.

Pesticide — I spray the weed killer once after the wheat comes up, and when I see the 蚜虫 (aphids) I spray once more. Sometimes twice if they're bad.

For the maize, after wheat harvest in June I don't plow — I just push the seed in with the machine through the straw. Everyone does it this way now, saves time and the land is moist. I use the hybrid seed from the 种子站 (seed station) — the tall ones, Zhengdan or whatever they have. I put compound fertilizer when I plant, then when the maize is waist-high I add urea — a little more than half a bag per mu. Maize is hungry, it needs fertilizer to fill the cob.

Maize I only water once or twice — summer has some rain. Pesticide once for the 玉米螟 (corn borer) when I see the holes in the leaves.

I expect wheat maybe 900 jin per mu if heaven gives good weather, maize maybe 1000-1100 jin. Last year was about that.
